proposed_capability: PS-0245 bounded duration-aware Bellman-style stochastic activity planning on top of PS-0241 observed activity DAG and route evidence. Preserves existing native and human-first owners; no desktop or in-game actions.
player_save_control_impact: Read-only deterministic policy calculations; no Sims save, host settings, desktop input, game queue, mutation, cheating, ambient telemetry or unattended agent activation.
expected_outcome: Typed per-actor evidence-backed state, exact preconditions, conservative need rates/floors, inventory acquisition, time-sensitive route alternatives, finite bounded stochastic expected utility and explicit deferred/interrupt resume checkpoints; one proposal only.
negative_tests: Human input / unknown scene / stale observation abstains
Insufficient funds, missing unlock, missing inventory, infeasible deadlines and below-floor needs deny
Action and route reuse cannot loop
Unreconciled in-flight or stale completion never replays
Bounded expansions, horizon, depth and queue capacity
Forecast has deterministic defaults and no GP dependency
rollback_path: Revert feature branch; no game, save, installation, OS or account changes.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact EA-native patch APIs and packaged activation
Actual player takeover/gameplay correctness in disposable save
Empirical utility coefficients and probability calibration for live Sims actions
decision_rationale: P141 compared: replace domain cascade with monolithic optimizer (REJECT: duplicate owner), blanket GP for every step (DEFER: not calibrated), add desktop click agent (REJECT: breaks native/player boundary), and add a bounded optimizer consuming PS-0241 observed DAG (SELECT: reversible, testable, preserves existing owners). P95/P82 evaluate real finite-horizon tradeoffs, P08 live blocked without game host, P07/P124 provide tested integration and receipt.
